name: Waiting for you
when: Your turn: an answer, a choice or more detail

variants.name: Expectant
variants.desc: Glances down at the message box, then back up at you.

variants.name: Tap tap
variants.desc: Taps on the glass, leaving little ripples.

variants.name: Your turn
variants.desc: An empty speech bubble with a blinking cursor.

variants.name: Yawn
variants.desc: Stretches tall with a big yawn while it waits.

variants.name: Clock
variants.desc: Watches a little clock tick round.

parts.t: <g class="att att-mouth"><ellipse class="a mth" fill="{{a.eye}}" cx="{{a.mx}}" cy="{{a.my}}" rx="3.6" ry="4.6"></ellipse></g>

<g class="fx-tapglass" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.mo}})"><g transform="translate(85 66)"><circle class="a rip" cx="0" cy="0" r="5"></circle><circle class="a rip" cx="0" cy="0" r="5"></circle><g class="a tp"><ellipse class="hc" cx="0" cy="0" rx="4" ry="3.4"></ellipse></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-cbub" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(80 6)"><rect class="pw" x="-13" y="-6" width="26" height="12" rx="6"></rect><rect class="a ccur dk" x="-8" y="-3.5" width="1.6" height="7" rx=".8"></rect><circle class="head" cx="7" cy="0" r="3.2"></circle></g></g>

<g class="fx-clock" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(85 12)"><circle class="pw" cx="0" cy="0" r="8.5"></circle><path class="line2" d="M0 -6.5V-5M6.5 0H5M0 6.5V5M-6.5 0H-5"></path><g class="vb0 chand"><path class="lnk2" d="M0 0V-5.5"></path></g><g class="vb0 cmin"><path class="lnk2" d="M0 0H3.8"></path></g><circle class="dk" cx="0" cy="0" r="1.2"></circle></g></g>
